component.name: The Long View
component.summary: See the years of life you win back by quitting smoking

description.p: Enter your age, how long you have smoked and how much. The Long View shows the time smoking has likely cost you, and how much of it comes back the longer you stay smoke free.
Log each day in a few seconds. A lapse costs real time, and it never erases the healing that already happened. A daily reminder comes at the time you pick.
The forecast, daily check-ins and your whole history are free. Premium adds the quit plan, money saved, sync across your devices, the recovery timeline and export.

screenshot.caption: Today: the time you are winning back
